name: Bigthan
overview: Bigthan, identified as one of the king's chamberlains who guarded the door, is portrayed in Scripture as a conspirator against King Ahasuerus. Alongside Teresh, Bigthan plotted to harm the king, but their scheme was uncovered through Mordecai's vigilance and communicated to Queen Esther. The conspiracy was investigated, resulting in their execution, which highlights God's providential protection over the king and the unfolding of His sovereign plan as recorded in the royal chronicles.
